title: Uka Articulado Ajllitaxa
intro: Diosan arunakapajj saraqankäna uka qollun chʼiwipanjja, qorit qhantʼataw mä markan iyawsäwipajj mayjtʼäna. Mä almax, wali suma arsuñ churatawa, mä jach’a misión ukar yanapt’irjamaw sayt’asiwayi, ukampirus mä juk’a pachaw jach’a yant’awinakamp uñjasi. Kunapachatï ajllit yatiyirix qullan nombramientor makhatkäna ukhaxa, uka jaqix qhipharuw qhiparäna, jan samarañ munir markaruw achiktʼasïna. ¿Khitis aka jan saytʼir almajj idolonakar yupaychañ contrajj arsüna?
clues: Nayax Allah jupan ajllitätwa mä profetajataki, ukampirus sarnaqäwijax yaqhamp chikaw yatiyasi.
Mä tirano apnaqiriruw khitapxitäna, ukampis lurañajax yanaptʼañakïnwa, janiw pʼiqtʼañakïkänti.
Nayajj wali suma arunak parlañ churirïtwa, arunakajajj chuymanakar llampʼuchañatakiw lurasïna.
Kunapachatï masijax mä qullan cita ukar sarxäna ukhaxa, jan samarañ munir jaqinakar irpañatakiw jaytatäyäta.
Jan paciencianïpjjatap laykojja, kʼachachtʼäwinakapatwa mä uñachtʼäw lurapjjerïna, ukat nayajj jupanakaruw achiktʼasiyäta, Diosar jan jitheqtapjjañapataki.
Compañerojajj kuttʼanisaw katuntawayitu, ukampis jaqenakajj atipjapjjetäna ukat niyaw jiwayapjjetäna sasaw qhanañchtʼayäta; Nayajj janiw jan wali luririnaka taypinkäyätti.

arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
